abilities.name: Own Tempo
abilities.effect: Prevents confusion.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon sticks to its own tempo, preventing it from becoming confused or being affected by Intimidate.

abilities.name: Static
abilities.effect: Has a 30% chance of paralyzing attacking Pokémon on contact.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon is charged with static electricity and may paralyze attackers that make direct contact with it.

abilities.name: Damp
abilities.effect: Prevents Self-Destruct, Explosion, and Aftermath from working while the Pokémon is in battle.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon dampens its surroundings, preventing all Pokémon from using explosive moves such as Self-Destruct.

abilities.name: Guts
abilities.effect: Increases Attack to 1.5× with a major status ailment.
abilities.flavor_text: It's so gutsy that having a status condition boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat.

abilities.name: Scrappy
abilities.effect: Lets the Pokémon's Normal and Fighting moves hit Ghost Pokémon.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon can hit Ghost-type Pokémon with Normal- and Fighting-type moves. It is also unaffected by Intimidate.

abilities.name: Flame Body
abilities.effect: Has a 30% chance of burning attacking Pokémon on contact.
abilities.flavor_text: Contact with the Pokémon may burn the attacker.

abilities.name: Gale Wings
abilities.effect: Raises Flying moves' priority by one stage.
abilities.flavor_text: Gives priority to the Pokémon's Flying-type moves while its HP is full.

abilities.name: Run Away
abilities.effect: Ensures success fleeing from wild battles.
abilities.flavor_text: Enables a sure getaway from wild Pokémon.

abilities.name: Pickup
abilities.effect: Picks up other Pokémon's used and Flung held items.  May also pick up an item after battle.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon may pick up an item another Pokémon used during a battle. It may pick up items outside of battle, too.

abilities.name: Own Tempo
abilities.effect: Prevents confusion.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon sticks to its own tempo, preventing it from becoming confused or being affected by Intimidate.

abilities.name: Chlorophyll
abilities.effect: Doubles Speed during strong sunlight.
abilities.flavor_text: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in harsh sunlight.

abilities.name: Leaf Guard
abilities.effect: Protects against major status ailments during strong sunlight.
abilities.flavor_text: Prevents status conditions in harsh sunlight.

abilities.name: Regenerator
abilities.effect: Heals for 1/3 max HP upon switching out.
abilities.flavor_text: The Pokémon has a little of its HP restored when withdrawn from battle.
